show private key message: Anyone who obtains your private key can take full control of your account
reveal private key body unlock: Anyone who obtains your private key can take full control of your account.
sign out private key warning: Once you sign out you will be required to re-enter your private key if you have logged in with it. Make sure you have it stored somewhere before proceeding further.
delete account data description:
This operation will delete all the data related to your profile including your network and posts but not your profile itself, which you can still use in other applications that supports it.

If you want to delete also the profile, please select the "Delete Profile" option instead
delete profile description:
Are you sure you want to delete your profile?

Your profile and all the data related to it will be permanently deleted.
